_meta.why: Known-debt baseline for the D812 enum control-shape gate. These are 2-5-option enums whose RENDERED LABEL (not slug) is <=12 chars but which currently render as SelectControl instead of ToggleGroupControl. Ratchet: --check fails on any NEW violation, never on these. NOT a fix-immediately list -- see decisions.md D812 + this branch's session notes for why the gate's own count (45) differs from D812's slug-derived estimate (85).
_meta.design_exempt_note: Entries carrying a 'reason' field are NOT debt -- they are correctly-resolved D812 violations that conflict with a separate, more specific Bean-locked rule and are baselined permanently, not pending conversion. quote.attributionFontStyle: its real control lives in the shared TypographyControls component (prefix='attribution', showStyle), whose font-style row is explicitly SelectControl per CLAUDE.md's Bean-locked R-22-13 ('weight + style = SelectControl dropdowns') -- converting it to ToggleGroupControl would violate that rule, which governs every TypographyControls adopter, not just this one block.  ⚠ 2026-09-07: quote.attributionFontStyle is NO LONGER in this file -- it is a 5-option enum, so the amended band (see bandAmended) makes it a neutral case rather than a by-design exemption. This note is kept because the R-22-13 reasoning still explains WHY that control is a SelectControl, and would apply again if the band ever narrowed back.
_meta.dispositionVocabularyNote: Closed vocabulary: by-design (correct, will never need fixing) / accepted-debt (real gap, consciously deferred) / detector-limitation (the checker itself is wrong — flags a rule violation per THE-MIGRATION-METHOD.md:455, not a normal outcome) / blocked (waiting on something external). See .claude/archive/parking.md P-BASELINE-DISPOSITION-VOCABULARY / .claude/LEDGER.md.
_meta.bandAmended: 2026-09-07 (Bean): the enforced band is 2-4 options, not 2-5. FIVE options is now a NEUTRAL band -- ToggleGroupControl and SelectControl are both correct there and neither is recorded as a violation. Five short options is the real judgement call in the D812 table: the width at which a segmented row starts to crowd a narrow inspector sidebar and a dropdown stops feeling heavy-handed. The gate now declines to have an opinion rather than booking churn as debt. Effect: 46 violations -> 29; the 17 entries dropped below are not FIXED, they are no longer violations by the amended rule.

violations.reason: The gate's proximity-window heuristic (WINDOW=900) mis-binds this attribute to the unrelated <ToggleGroupControl> that controls a DIFFERENT attribute, toggleIcon (bars/speaker) — 898 chars away, just inside the window, and closer than either real <SelectControl> in the file. Verified 2026-09-26: playerStyle's real UI is a hand-rolled <button> grid (two grouped rows, static vs audio-reactive styles, each with a name + hint line) — it uses neither ToggleGroupControl nor SelectControl, so this 8-option enum should resolve 'unresolved' (one of the 612 blind-spot enums), not as a D812 violation. Same false-bind class already fixed for card-grid.layout, media.mediaType and quote.attributionFontStyle (see find_marks() docstring) — this one is architecturally the same failure, just still inside WINDOW.
